backend/main.mo: Main actor for the pepper farm bookkeeping app, handling user authentication, auto-admin bootstrap registration, user profile management, and an approval workflow with access control guards.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that upgrades all stored records (inventory, customers, income, expenses, sales, workers, daily records) by adding an `enteredBy` field defaulting to 'unknown'.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features—VerificationTab pending-user display and 'Entered By' columns across data tabs—to their relevant files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and recent changes of each component, hook, utility, and page in the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app titled 'Pepper Farm Bookkeeping Application', mounting the app at `#root` and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component orchestrating authentication state, bootstrap registration, profile setup, approval status checks, and conditional rendering of LoginPrompt, WaitingForApprovalScreen, or Dashboard.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying the current year and a caffeine.ai attribution link with dynamic UTM parameters based on the app's hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header component displaying the Pepper Farm Bookkeeping title, logged-in user's name, and a login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Landing page shown to unauthenticated users, featuring a hero image and cards describing the app's key features (income tracking, inventory, customers, dashboard).
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts a newly authenticated user to enter their name to create their profile before accessing the app.
frontend/src/components/RejectedScreen.t: Screen shown to users whose access request was rejected, displaying an error message and a sign-out button.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AttendanceT: Tab for managing farm workers, allowing users to view a list of workers and add new ones with a name and role via a dialog form.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CustomersTa: Tab for managing customers with search, add-customer dialog, and a per-customer purchase history dialog showing sales records.
React tab component for managing farm expense records with full CRUD operations, category filtering, search, and NGN currency formatting.
frontend/src/components/tabs/FarmTimeTab: React tab component displaying a monthly calendar grid for tracking worker attendance, arrival/departure times, and daily presence records.
frontend/src/components/tabs/IncomeTab.t: React tab component for adding and viewing farm income records with source filtering, search, and NGN currency formatting.
frontend/src/components/tabs/InventoryTa: React tab component for managing farm inventory items with add/edit support, type filtering, search, and total value calculation.
frontend/src/components/tabs/SalesTab.ts: React tab component for recording and viewing farm sales transactions, linking customers and inventory items with revenue totals.
Displays a financial dashboard summary with cards for total income, expenses, net profit, inventory value, low-stock alerts, and a list of recent transactions, with loading skeletons while data fetches.
frontend/src/components/tabs/Verificatio: Admin tab for managing user access approvals, showing pending and processed requests in tables with approve/reject actions via alert dialogs.
frontend/src/components/WaitingForApprov: Screen shown to users pending admin approval, allowing them to send an approval request and check their current approval status.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing admin access control and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider component, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the backend actor, covering user profiles, approvals, inventory, income, expenses, sales, customers, workers, and attendance CRUD operations with toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining light and dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens, radii, and sidebar variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page rendering a tabbed layout with tabs for Summary, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time, and an admin-only Verification tab.
frontend/src/utils/farmTime.ts: Date/time utility functions for the Farm Time calendar feature, including month grid generation, nanosecond conversion helpers for backend communication, and formatting functions for time, duration, and date display.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom design system with OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking existing features and pending feature requests, primarily focused on completing admin user approval logic and adding an 'Entered By' column to all entry tables across the application.
